about.description: The Lil Yachty Walkout is a viral meme from his 2021 Lyrical Lemonade Summer Smash performance. As "Coffin" plays, Yachty walks on stage with an exaggerated, confident swagger that became the perfect template for AI dance videos.

faq.description: Everything you need to know about creating Lil Yachty walk videos

items.question: Is this better than Viggle AI?
items.answer: For this specific trend, yes. Viggle requires Discord and command-line inputs. Our tool is web-based - just upload and click. Same quality, 10x easier.

items.question: What photos work best?
items.answer: Front-facing photos with the full body or at least torso visible work best. The AI needs to see enough of the figure to apply the walking motion. High resolution photos produce better results.

items.question: Can I use celebrity photos?
items.answer: Yes, that's actually what makes these videos go viral - the unexpected contrast. Just be mindful of your country's laws regarding deepfakes when posting publicly.

items.question: Does the video include the Coffin audio?
items.answer: Yes! The audio is pre-synced with the motion template. Your generated video is ready to post with no editing needed.

items.question: How long is the generated video?
items.answer: The Lil Yachty Walk template generates 5-8 second videos - the perfect length for TikTok's algorithm to boost your content.

items.question: Why is this called 'Lil Yachty Walk' or 'Lil Yachty Walkout'?
items.answer: It comes from rapper Lil Yachty's entrance at the 2021 Lyrical Lemonade Summer Smash festival. The original video of him walking on stage with his signature swagger went viral again in 2024-2025 when AI tools made it possible to put any face on the walk.
